notes: legacy = pre-index directed-wake coordinator; before = indexed baseline; after = indexed baseline + duplicate stable-path invalidation removed
Three alternating batches, each one unreported warmup plus three recorded trials; 4 workers, 1000 total appends, 200 renames; 32 or 8192 registered streams
Profiles contain observer overhead, are separate runs, and must not be compared in absolute throughput with uninstrumented runs
Five stage intervals partition each operation. write_ns and wake_to_poll_ns overlap stages and must not be added to them
Wake probe observes only the writer future, not OS thread dispatch or the spawned store future; pre_store includes coordinator admission and dispatch, not pure lock wait
Prewarm is two complete unrelated renames outside timing, including metadata/storage work; exact index construction is separately microbenchmarked
Historical binaries share the measured benchmark and observer logic; the later standalone correctness test is absent from before/after release binaries and present in final debug regression
No HTTP/JNI or cloud throughput inferred
